sources.quote: Hacker stole personnel data about thousands of Homeland Security employees, including CBP and ICE agents
including those in US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Customs and Border Protection (CBP)

claims.statement: A hacker stole personal data belonging to DHS employees, including ICE and CBP agents.

sources.quote: The breach exposes the names, job titles, phone numbers, email addresses, and office locations

claims.statement: The stolen data includes names, job titles, phone numbers, email addresses, and office locations.

sources.quote: which has since been published online

claims.statement: The stolen data has since been published online.

discrepancies.explanation: TechCrunch reports more than 40,000 affected employees, while The Verge reports more than 41,000.

analysis.headline: Hacker steals personnel data on thousands of DHS employees
analysis.summary: A hacker stole personal information belonging to tens of thousands of Department of Homeland Security employees, including ICE and CBP personnel, and the data has since been published online. Reports differ slightly on the exact number of employees affected, citing more than 40,000 or more than 41,000.
